name: Mutated Brown Mold

source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril

disable: DC 25 Survival check (trained) to safely remove the mold
reset: After expanding, the brown mold can't grow again for 1 day.

items.name: Emit Cold
items.text: 10 feet. Enhanced brown mold deals 2d8+7 cold damage to nearby creatures.

items.name: Leech Warmth
items.text:
Trigger Fire comes within 5 feet of the brown mold.

---

Effect The brown mold expands into every square adjacent to its space. As it grows, it pulls more heat from its surroundings, dealing 4d8+14 cold damage (DC 24 basic Fortitude save save) to creatures within 15 feet after it expands.

text: This unassuming fungus leeches heat out of the air.
